title: Separate integration-head and post-merge verification modes
purpose: Correct the classified harness topology defect by making integration-head and post-merge verification explicit, fail-closed and independently auditable while preserving the released product bytes and the existing product test suite.
invariants: The implementation branch starts directly from commit 0604cad79a8ca765148c30090906b9f658af7109 and any later synchronization is explicitly reported.
Only the four exact allowed paths may change.
All four authorized paths already exist at the baseline; no file creation, deletion, rename or path substitution is authorized.
Mode selection is explicit and unknown or missing modes fail closed.
Integration-head mode retains the frozen four-parent topology and accepted-input provenance checks.
Post-merge mode verifies the expected two-parent ancestry, accepted integration-head identity and zero executable-tree divergence before build and product verification.
Topology, provenance, build and product failures remain distinct machine-readable classifications.
Product tests are not skipped because a topology mode is inappropriate.
The push workflow on main selects post-merge mode explicitly and pull-request integration verification selects integration-head mode explicitly.
The pre-existing 30 product tests remain present and pass with zero skip, failure or error; newly added topology tests are counted explicitly.
The released v1.0.0 artifact remains exactly learnit-next.html, 84060 bytes, SHA-256 53ab18a61fdac152117a4c098bfa991c14970334bad00dffc9ae14fc2c1b0ef4.
No product behavior, runtime source, authoring, contract, governance-state or RC718 content changes.
Merge remains held until all required gates, independent QA reproduction and governor review pass.
requiredEvidence: A design note is posted on issue #85 before the first implementation commit.
The exact changed-path report contains only the four authorized existing files.
Clean-checkout evidence exercises both explicit modes and records commands, versions, return codes and machine-readable reports.
Regression coverage includes valid and invalid integration topology, valid and invalid post-merge provenance, executable-tree divergence, unknown or missing mode and distinct failure classifications.
The complete product suite and all new topology tests pass with zero skip, failure or error.
Two deterministic builds reproduce exactly 84060 bytes and SHA-256 53ab18a61fdac152117a4c098bfa991c14970334bad00dffc9ae14fc2c1b0ef4.
An independent QA agent reproduces the result without relying on implementation self-certification.
The governor reviews the independently reproduced evidence before merge.
A controlled post-merge verification is required after merge.
adversarialTests: Valid four-parent integration topology passes its provenance stage.
Invalid integration parent order fails closed.
A moved frozen base fails closed in integration-head mode.
Valid two-parent post-merge topology reaches build and product checks.
Wrong accepted integration-head identity fails closed.
Executable-tree divergence from the accepted integration head fails closed.
Unknown or missing mode fails closed.
Topology and product failures produce distinct machine-readable classifications.
Existing and newly added tests are counted from actual execution rather than a hard-coded total.
Any added, deleted, renamed or unauthorized path fails scope validation.
nonGoals: Changing product runtime behavior or user experience.
Changing authoring tools, kits, contracts or schemas.
Migrating, modifying or adding compatibility for RC718.
Adding product features or new test files.
Retroactively altering the v1.0.0 release evidence chain.
Authorizing merge before independent QA and governor review.
independentReview: Independent QA reproduces both topology modes, regression tests, deterministic builds and the complete product suite from clean checkouts.
The governor verifies exact baseline provenance, four-path scope, immutable artifact identity and distinct failure classifications.
Merge is prohibited until repository gates, independent QA and governor review all pass.
rollback: Close the implementation pull request without merge, or revert only the four-path CI correction commit. The released product artifact and RC718 remain unchanged.
